# Apify Paid Report Starter Kits

Catalog inputs for 8 source-linked Apify report Actors. The seven deployment actors start with a free static sample (`sample=true`, `dryRun=true`, `maxChargeUsd=0`), then offer a separate paid preview capped at $0.25 and an opt-in full-report input. Static samples are illustrative and are not live data.

## Catalog

- [Technical SEO & AI Crawler Audit](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/technical-seo-portfolio-regression-report/): Find indexability and AI crawler access regressions across authorized sites. Sources: Public pages, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt.
- [Apple Podcasts Category Benchmark](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/podcast-category-network-benchmark-report/): Compare public show, category, publisher, and episode signals before a full benchmark. Sources: Apple Podcasts metadata and public RSS feeds.
- [Apple Podcasts / iTunes Scraper: Search, Charts, Episodes](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/apple-podcasts-scraper/): Related discovery Actor. Cheapest first paid run: small search, `includeEpisodes` false ([starter JSON](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/inputs/apple-podcast-scraper.json)). Pricing: Result $2.50/1,000. Start $0.005. Store: [taroyamada/apple-podcast-scraper](https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-scraper).
- [Article Extractor & Reader Scraper (News, Blog, RAG)](https://apify.com/taroyamada/article-content-extractor): Related content-extraction Actor. Cheapest first paid run: one public article URL, `generateReport` false, `emitExport` false ([starter JSON](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/inputs/article-content-extractor.json), [Make input](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/make/article-content-extractor.json), [n8n input](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/n8n/article-content-extractor.json)). Pricing: Actor Start $0.00005. Useful article row $0.008. Store: [taroyamada/article-content-extractor](https://apify.com/taroyamada/article-content-extractor).
- [G2 & Capterra Review Scraper](https://apify.com/taroyamada/g2-capterra-review-intelligence): Related B2B review intelligence Actor. Cheapest first paid run: one review page URL, modest `reviewLimit` (25), `dryRun` false ([starter JSON](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/inputs/g2-capterra-review-intelligence.json), [Make input](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/make/g2-capterra-review-intelligence.json), [n8n input](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/n8n/g2-capterra-review-intelligence.json)). Pricing: Actor Start $0.001. result $0.01. Store: [taroyamada/g2-capterra-review-intelligence](https://apify.com/taroyamada/g2-capterra-review-intelligence).
- [Apple Podcasts Chart Scraper](https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-chart-tracker): Related chart-tracking Actor. Cheapest first paid run: one US storefront, chart depth 3, `generateMovementReport` false ([starter JSON](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/inputs/apple-podcast-chart-tracker.json), [Make input](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/make/apple-podcast-chart-tracker.json), [n8n input](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/n8n/apple-podcast-chart-tracker.json)). Pricing: apify-default-dataset-item $0.003. Store: [taroyamada/apple-podcast-chart-tracker](https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-chart-tracker).
- [Apple Podcasts Reviews Scraper](https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-reviews-monitor): Related reviews Actor. Cheapest first paid run: snapshot mode, one podcast ID, one country, `maxPagesPerPair` 1, `generateReport` false ([starter JSON](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/inputs/apple-podcast-reviews-monitor.json), [Make input](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/make/apple-podcast-reviews-monitor.json), [n8n input](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/n8n/apple-podcast-reviews-monitor.json)). Pricing: apify-default-dataset-item $0.003. Store: [taroyamada/apple-podcast-reviews-monitor](https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-reviews-monitor).
- [TED, SAM.gov & Grants Bid Alerts Scraper](https://apify.com/taroyamada/procurement-intel-actor): Related procurement intelligence Actor. Cheapest first paid run: TED-only (`jurisdictions` eu), `generateReport` false, `emitExport` false ([starter JSON](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/inputs/procurement-intel-actor.json)). Pricing: Procurement opportunity or alert row $0.008. Store: [taroyamada/procurement-intel-actor](https://apify.com/taroyamada/procurement-intel-actor).
- [Clinical Trials & PubMed Evidence Gap Report](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/biomedical-trial-literature-evidence-report/): Compare trial records and publications to surface source-linked evidence gaps. Sources: ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed APIs.
- [App Store Release & Review Benchmark](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/app-release-category-review-benchmark-report/): Compare releases, ratings, and review samples around app release windows. Sources: Public Apple App Store and Google Play metadata.
- [npm & PyPI Dependency Risk Report](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/package-portfolio-upgrade-risk-report/): Check package versions and vulnerability evidence before a portfolio report. Sources: npm, PyPI, and OSV public APIs.
- [CPSC & NHTSA Recall Portfolio Watch](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/product-safety-market-action-portfolio-report/): Monitor official recall records across product and vehicle watchlists. Sources: CPSC and NHTSA public records.
- [eCFR & Federal Register Change Report](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/regulatory-obligation-change-impact-report/): Track source-linked CFR sections and Federal Register notices by watchlist. Sources: eCFR and Federal Register public APIs.
- [PubMed Literature Watch & Research Report](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/pubmed-research-intelligence/): Monitor official PubMed citation metadata and generate source-linked literature reports and screening exports. Sources: NCBI PubMed E-utilities.

## Make and n8n

- [Make and n8n first paid runs](https://github.com/luxslime/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/blob/master/integrations/README.md): Paste-ready Actor input for Make Run an Actor and n8n Run Actor Custom input. Same cheapest first paid runs as `inputs/` for Article Extractor, G2 & Capterra, Apple Podcasts Chart, and Apple Podcasts Reviews.

## Guides

- [Apple Podcasts scraper Apify: RSS vs Store notes](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/guides/apple-podcasts-scraper-apify/): Factual comparison of RSS collection vs Store / iTunes API scrapers. Covers search, charts, episodes, and watchlists. Actor: https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-scraper. Price: Result $2.50/1,000. Start $0.005.
- [Apple Podcasts charts](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/guides/apple-podcasts-charts.md)
- [Apple Podcasts watchlists](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/guides/apple-podcasts-watchlists.md)
- [Apple Podcasts search and discovery](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/guides/apple-podcasts-search-discovery.md): Cheapest first paid run. Small `searchTerm`, `includeEpisodes` false. Store: https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-scraper

## Discovery tools

- [Apple Podcasts Scraper](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/tools/apple-podcasts-scraper/): Search, charts, and watchlists via official Apple/iTunes endpoints. No proxy. Price: Result $2.50/1,000. Start $0.005. Store: https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-scraper
- [Search](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/tools/apple-podcasts-scraper/search.html): cheapest first paid run; iTunes Search API via `searchTerm`, `includeEpisodes` false
- [Charts](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/tools/apple-podcasts-scraper/charts.html): storefront rankings via `chartRequests`
- [Watchlists](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/tools/apple-podcasts-scraper/watchlists.html): collection ID refresh via `lookupIds`
- [Webhooks](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/tools/apple-podcasts-scraper/webhooks.html): `delivery` `webhook` plus `webhookUrl`; `dryRun` does not send webhooks
- [Dataset fields](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/tools/apple-podcasts-scraper/dataset-fields.html): Store-documented output fields; default dataset is the billable surface

## Buyer workflows

- [Podcast Discovery Workflow](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/bundles/podcast-discovery/): Use Apple Podcasts Scraper as step-0 discovery, then move into the Apple Podcasts Category Benchmark report. Pricing: Result $2.50/1,000. Start $0.005. Store: [taroyamada/apple-podcast-scraper](https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-scraper).
- [Podcast Media Planning Workflow](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/bundles/podcast-media-planning/): Benchmark public podcast metadata first, then move from a category signal to a source-linked planning report.
- [Biomedical Research Evidence Workflow](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/bundles/research-regulatory-evidence/): Use official trial and literature sources to triage evidence gaps without treating registry or citation metadata as clinical conclusions.
- [Engineering & Product Operations Workflow](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/bundles/engineering-product-operations/): Start with bounded audits for authorized sites, app reviews, and dependency risk before enabling portfolio reports.
- [Regulatory & Product Safety Workflow](https://luxslime.github.io/apify-paid-report-starter-kits/bundles/regulatory-safety-operations/): Monitor official recall records and regulatory changes, then route source-linked evidence into human review without presenting the output as advice.

## Usage and billing

- Review live Apify Store pricing before a paid run.
- Use the paid preview input before the separate full-report input.
- Zero-row and unchanged monitor runs have zero event charge.
- Outputs are research and workflow inputs, not legal, medical, investment, procurement, safety-certification, ranking, or business-outcome advice.
